name: SD: a web shop that runs short of stock (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A small web shop's daily records over two years: customer orders waiting to be picked, orders at the packing bench, the stock on the shelves, and the purchase orders the supplier has not yet dispatched. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-webshop-stock/truth.model.json, including a stock the records do not show: goods on the road), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests effects on the shelf's outflow and inflow: low shelves slow picking (a linear effect), and a big backlog of customer orders makes the buyer reorder faster (a saturating table effect). Demand rises and falls without being announced.
